title: vaporize install --artifact app --xcode-project drives xcodebuild but reports 'App bundle not found' because the locator never searched the xcodebuild DerivedData output
closeReason: The resolved DerivedData path is shared by xcodebuild invocation and post-build app discovery; the implementation is present in commit d23b9bc0 and covered by the recorded CUJ-02 verification.
createdBy: opus harness after operator surfaced the gap by USING vaporize install --artifact app --xcode-project

historicalContent.triggeredBy: Running `vaporize install --artifact app --xcode-project X.xcodeproj --scheme S` (without --derived-data-path) drives xcodebuild correctly, the build SUCCEEDS, but vaporize then reports 'App bundle not found'.
historicalContent.rootCause: In sources/swift-app-installer/SwiftAppInstaller.swift, `Request.xcodeBuildInvocation()` only appended `-derivedDataPath` when `derivedDataPath` or `xcodeProductCacheDerivedDataPath` was explicitly set. With neither set, xcodebuild wrote the product into its DEFAULT `~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/<Project>-<hash>/Build/Products/<Config>/NAME.app`. Meanwhile `buildCandidates(for:configuration:product:)` only added a DerivedData candidate when `request.derivedDataPath` was non-nil, otherwise searching solely SwiftPM `.build/apple/Products/...` and `.build/<config>/...` layouts. The xcodebuild output directory and the locator directory were therefore never aligned, yielding InstallerError.appBundleNotFound on a successful build. Secondary: the xcodebuild step ran under `.summary` log exposure, so compile/link errors were not surfaced.
fixSummary: Added `Request.resolvedXcodeDerivedDataPath` — a single source of truth for the non-cache DerivedData path. When an Xcode project/workspace build is requested without an explicit `--derived-data-path` (and without a shared product cache), it synthesizes a stable package-local default `<packagePath>/.build/vaporize-xcode-derived-data`.
`xcodeBuildInvocation()` now pins `-derivedDataPath` to `resolvedXcodeDerivedDataPath` (product cache still takes precedence), so xcodebuild always writes to a directory vaporize controls.
`buildCandidates(...)` now derives its DerivedData candidate from `resolvedXcodeDerivedDataPath`, so the post-build locator searches exactly where xcodebuild wrote the `.app`.

The SwiftPM `.build/...` candidates are unchanged, and the SwiftPM `xcrun swift build` path is untouched (its locator still resolves via the unchanged `.build` layouts because `resolvedXcodeDerivedDataPath` returns nil when no Xcode container is configured).
The xcodebuild build now runs under `.verbose` log exposure (tags build=xcodebuild) so compile/link failures are visible in the receipt instead of being swallowed.
historicalContent.expectedBehavior: An `--artifact app --xcode-project/--xcode-workspace` install whose xcodebuild succeeds must locate and install the built `.app`, and a failing xcodebuild must surface its compiler output.
codeTouchpoints: sources/swift-app-installer/SwiftAppInstaller.swift: buildApp() (split log exposure), buildCandidates() (resolvedXcodeDerivedDataPath), Request.xcodeBuildInvocation() (-derivedDataPath from resolved path), Request.resolvedXcodeDerivedDataPath + defaultXcodeDerivedDataDirectoryName (new).
testsAdded: tests/cuj-02-mac-app: 'CUJ-02 synthesizes a package-local derived data path when none is provided for an Xcode build' (invocation now pins -derivedDataPath).
tests/cuj-02-mac-app: 'CUJ-02 locates the Xcode-built app under the synthesized derived data directory' (locator finds NAME.app under the DerivedData-style Build/Products/<Config>/).
tests/cuj-02-mac-app: 'CUJ-02 SwiftPM layout is still located when no Xcode build is configured' (SwiftPM locator regression guard).
Updated existing 'CUJ-02 defaults Xcode destination when using xcodebuild' to expect the synthesized -derivedDataPath.
